test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state among the following launched the Aama Yojana in the year 2022, to give ₹20,000 each to non-working mothers?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sikkim**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sikkim government has launched** "Aama Yojana "** in March 2022 which will be implemented soon.** **
 
• The chief minister has also launched** "Bahini yojana"**
 
• Under the Aama yojana all non working women will receive 20,000 Annually from the state government.
 
• Under the Bahini yojana State Government will provide sanitary napkins to the girls' students. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

Sikkim is a northeast state in India.

__
 
• Capital:- Gangtok
 
• Chief Minister:- Shri Prem Singh Tamang
 
• Population 2011 - 6,10,577
 
• Child Sex Ratio - 957

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Some Schemes in Sikkim.**

 
• **Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA)**

 
 
• **​** Appreciating the work done by ASHA.
 
• Honorarium of Rs. 3000/- per month will be given.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister Rural Housing Scheme**
 
 
• **​**Aimed to bring about a qualitative improvement in the housing status of the poor by providing them a housing grant
 
 
 
• **Dairy Development Programme**
 
 
• **​**Targeting development, sustainability and rural prosperity.
 
 
 
• **Comprehensive Educational Load Scheme (CELS)**
 
 
• ** **Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme (CELS) for pursuing higher/professional studies in India and abroad.
